semantics.edge_presence: a tested pair, including numerical zero

scope.setting: audited ns-3 simulator, three-cell topology, cached Sionna channels
scope.input_matching: input_matched; not serialized identical states or complete pre-treatment demand manifest
scope.intervention_definition: all other RCPs fixed; mediating network responses allowed

reasoning_rules: Edges are tested finite intervention contrasts at one joint RCP baseline, not structural direct causal links.
An edge exists even for numerical zero. Absence from a filtered view means hidden/not retrieved, not no effect.
Use observed deltas for effect magnitude; SHAP is model dependence and MAE is predictive error. Never interchange them.
Sign means increase/decrease of the measured KPI, not benefit/harm without an explicit objective.
Three trace scenarios are not three independent radio-seed repeats; six windows and reused controls are dependent.
All-positive/all-negative traces are descriptive repeatability, not statistical significance or calibrated confidence.
TxP(4g2) uses 1401,1403,1404 after failure on 1402. Keep original-only and supplemental summaries separate.
Do not extrapolate to another joint baseline, reverse/change the step, add simultaneous/sequential effects, or infer online control response.
Reference scope is t=0 fixed settings, 900s, audited simulator/trace/cache recipe; matching RCPs alone does not establish transportability.
No xApp identities/objectives, operational harm thresholds, or combined-action evidence are supplied. Identify tradeoffs, not confirmed xApp conflicts.
Do not use this summary adjacency for d-separation, mediation identification, or causal adjustment-set selection.
Derived KPI outputs are labelled and are not independent corroboration. Operational effect thresholds and population confidence intervals are unspecified.
Some loss_pct 150s windows were invalid under the existing 0..100% rule. Null deltas are missing, not zero; flag those relations for data-quality review even if their 900s aggregates are valid.
Cite edge IDs, action before/after, units and trace ranges when answering. For a decision, report applicability and unresolved context.
